roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role is crucial for maintaining high standards of patient care and staff competency within our facility. You will play a key role in shaping our clinical team's skills and ensuring a safe environment for all.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, conducting competency assessments, and overseeing all aspects of infection prevention and control. Your expertise will ensure compliance with regulatory standards and foster a culture of continuous improvement and safety.

This full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour, reflecting your valuable contributions to our team and residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license.
Proven experience in staff development and education.
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control.
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

description: Join a dynamic and growing skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL, recently acquired and poised for significant expansion. We are seeking an Experienced Marketing Director to lead our outreach efforts and drive census growth. This is a pivotal role for a proactive and results-oriented professional ready to make a substantial impact.The ideal candidate will be a highly presentable and energetic individual with a strong drive to succeed. You will be instrumental in developing and executing innovative marketing strategies, building strong community relationships, and ensuring our facility remains a top choice for rehabilitation and long-term care. This role requires flexibility, including working occasional weekends, to meet the demands of our vibrant community. We offer competitive compensation for the right individual who can demonstrate exceptional leadership and a proven ability to achieve ambitious goals.
requirements: Demonstrated professionalism and a highly presentable demeanor
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed
Proven success in marketing and business development, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare environment
Strong ability to drive results and achieve census objectives
Excellent communication, networking, and relationship-building skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and proven track record.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN (as needed) opportunity offers exceptional flexibility, allowing you to balance your professional commitments with your personal life while making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

In this vital role, you will provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients, helping them regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. You will work within a supportive environment, collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to develop and implement individualized treatment plans.

If you are a skilled Physical Therapist looking for a flexible schedule and the chance to contribute to a patient-centered facility, we encourage you to apply. This position offers competitive hourly compensation.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist (PT)
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work on a PRN (as needed) basis
Strong clinical assessment and treatment skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation for Physical Therapists is $39.00 - $40.00, based on experience.

roleTitle: Rehabilitation Therapist / Assistant (OT, PT, ST, COTA, PTA)
description:
We are seeking dedicated and compassionate Rehabilitation Therapists and Assistants to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. This is an excellent opportunity for Occupational Therapists, Physical Therapists, Speech Therapists, Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants, and Physical Therapist Assistants to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

Candidates will provide high-quality therapy services, contributing to a supportive and dynamic team environment focused on patient-centered care. Both full-time and part-time positions are available, offering flexibility to suit your professional needs.
requirements: Active state license/certification as an Occupational Therapist (OT), Physical Therapist (PT), Speech Therapist (ST), Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA), or Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA).
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation center setting.
Strong commitment to patient care and rehabilitation goals.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rates ranging from $28.00 to $46.00, depending on role and experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Internal Medicine Physician to join a reputable family health services center in Greenville, SC. This role offers a highly competitive compensation package, including a base salary of $210,000 and significant bonus opportunities, recognizing your expertise and commitment. We value work-life balance, providing great benefits and generous paid time off.

This position offers flexibility with part-time, PRN, or contract options, and we are open to candidates requiring travel or relocation assistance. We are committed to a supportive environment where your contributions are highly valued. Join a team that prioritizes patient care and professional growth.
salaryShort: $210,000 + up to $50,000 in bonuses per year
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board certification or eligibility in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Med/Pediatrics
Ability to obtain or hold a current, unrestricted medical license in South Carolina
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $210,000 annually, with an additional bonus structure up to $50,000. This includes a guaranteed bonus of $25,000 and a potential bonus of $25,000. A $9,000 portion of the bonus is payable on the first payday upon signing a promissory note.
